values.note: 50 full-hookup sites (42 sold by the night, 8 seasonal) and 3 tent sites. Sites 1-41 are back-in with 40-60 ft gravel pads; 42-50 are 100-ft pull-throughs, temporarily closed until the State of Minnesota inspects them.

sites.source: https://reservations.springfieldmn.org/rothenburg-campground/ ('Choose from 42 full hook-up RV sites ($40/night), 8 full hook-up seasonal RV sites ($1,920/season), or 3 non-electric tent sites'; 'Sites 42-50 are temporarily closed until sites are inspected by the State of MN.') + rules ('Sites 1-41 are BACK-IN ONLY with NO PULL-THROUGHS. Sites 42-50 are PULL-THROUGH SITES.') + campsite listings ('40 foot' to '60 foot Gravel pad'; nine '100 foot Gravel pad'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://reservations.springfieldmn.org/rothenburg-campground-campsites/ ('Water, Electric (30 & 50 amp), Sewer, Picnic Table, Fire Ring, Free WIFI'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://reservations.springfieldmn.org/rothenburg-campground/ ('access to two bathhouses with showers, and a dump station') + campsite listings ('Free WIFI'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Online through the city's reservation site (a new account is needed). The rules give a 7-day maximum; the rates page says campers staying longer than a week must move to a different site each week. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon; cancel 7 days ahead for a refund less $5.

booking.source: https://reservations.springfieldmn.org/rothenburg-campground-rules/ ('(7-day maximum Stay)'; 'There is no need to register upon arrival. Your receipt is proof of reservation.'; 'A notice of 7 days or more will result in a refund less a $5 transaction fee') + https://reservations.springfieldmn.org/rothenburg-campground/ ('Extended Stays: Campers staying longer than one week must move to a different site on a weekly basis.'; 'Check-in is at 2 p.m., and check-out is at 12 noon'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Full hookup $40 a night, $240 a week; tent sites $15; seasonal sites $1,920. Extra tents or campers cost more.

fees.source: https://reservations.springfieldmn.org/rothenburg-campground/ ('Full Hook-Up: $40/night or $240/week.'; 'Tent Site: $15/night.'; '8 full hook-up seasonal RV sites ($1,920/season)'; 'Additional charges apply for extra tents or campers.'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Springfield campground in a wooded bend of the Big Cottonwood River beside Riverside Park, two blocks from downtown; the park's pool, playgrounds, courts and canoe landing are next door, and paved trails run to the golf club. Some sewer sites need an extended hose. One vehicle per site; no parking on the grass. --Claude
summary: City reservation site, rules, site listings and map read: 50 FHU 30/50 A (42 nightly, 8 seasonal; pull-throughs 42-50 temporarily closed for state inspection) + 3 tent, $40/$240 week, 7-day maximum, showers, dump, WiFi. Riverview -> not waterfront proposed (creek-size channel behind trees). Website line consolidated; note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT riverview -> not waterfront (proposed): the stream is the Big Cottonwood River (the city map's name), which measures ~17-21 m wide at the campground on Esri z19 imagery - creek-size under the ~30 m line - and the campsites sit under a continuous tree band 20-40 m deep along its bank (loop ~44.2365,-94.9738). Creek-size water behind trees has no view value (there is no creek-view), and no pad is on open ground within ~50 m to earn creekside.
STATUS (partial): 'Sites 42-50 are temporarily closed until sites are inspected by the State of MN.' (the nine 100-ft pull-throughs); the 41 back-in sites are bookable. No date given.
LONG-STAY: 8 of 50 hookup sites are seasonal ($1,920); 42 are sold by the night with a 7-day maximum. Not seasonal in character.
SEASON: no campground opening or closing dates are published (only 'Reservations for the 2026 season begin on January 6th'); left unset.
